# Andreu World

> > Andreu World manufactures sustainable designer furniture for workspaces and hospitality, collaborating with renowned designers to create Cradle to Cradle certified products.

Andreu World is a Valencia-based furniture manufacturer specializing in contract furniture for commercial and hospitality environments. The company emphasizes circular economy principles and works with international designers like Patricia Urquiola and Benjamin Hubert to create innovative, environmentally certified seating and furniture collections.

## Key Topics

- Cradle to Cradle certification
- Sustainable furniture design
- Contract furniture
- Circular economy
- Designer collaborations
- Patricia Urquiola
- Benjamin Hubert
- Solo Chair
- Calma Lounge
- Valencia Stool
- Bolete Chair
- Quick-ship programs
- Workspace furniture
- Hospitality furniture
- Showrooms
